segments.t: 穿着一尘不染的白衬衫，阿瑟在后走廊停在汉娜和格雷厄姆身旁，急不可待地伸手去拿那把刷角落的小刷子。先完整听一遍吧。
What a lovely garden green! Give me a brush, the owner must help too!
Boss, you are wearing a snow white shirt and polished black shoes.
Just three neat slats on the bottom! I have a steady hand, watch!
Careful, Arthur, your sleeve is two centimeters from the wet edge...
Missed my shirt completely! Ha! Wait... my nose itches.
Arthur, do not lift the hand holding the green brush!
Why are you both staring at my forehead like that?
Because you just painted the left lens of your reading glasses bright green.
My glasses were on my forehead again?! Oh, everything looks like a forest!
Stand completely still! Warm water and a soft cloth: off it comes!
Clean as new! Thank you, Hannah... I think I will go supervise the front desk.
Wise decision, boss. Leave the wet paint to us.
现在，让我们一句一句来回味这段阿瑟帮倒忙的趣事。
What a lovely garden green! Give me a brush, the owner must help too!
「多美的庭院绿啊！给我一把刷子，老板也必须帮帮忙！」 在感叹某个单数可数名词构成的词组时，感叹句保留了不定冠词，
What a lovely garden green
表达出对这抹庭院绿色的喜爱之情。
Boss, you are wearing a snow white shirt and polished black shoes.
「老板，您可是穿着雪白的衬衫和擦得发亮的黑皮鞋呢。」 描述别人此刻正穿在身上的衣物时，英语习惯使用进行时，
you are wearing
搭配透明的比喻 snow white，生动地强调了他这身雪白衬衫实在不适合干活。
Just three neat slats on the bottom! I have a steady hand, watch!
「就在最下面刷三片整齐的百叶板！我手很稳的，看好了！」 无论对于外科医生、钟表匠，还是业余的粉刷匠，这个习惯用语
a steady hand
都能准确形容手持工具时平稳不抖的好习惯。
Careful, Arthur, your sleeve is two centimeters from the wet edge...
「小心，阿瑟，您的袖子离没干的边缘只有两厘米了……」 想要提醒别人眼前的危险，只需大声喊出一个形容词
Careful, Arthur
这就是 Be careful 简捷有力的口语表达形式。
Missed my shirt completely! Ha! Wait... my nose itches.
「完全避开了我的衬衫！哈！等等……我鼻子有点痒。」 在英语里表达身体某个部位发痒，直接把该部位作为主语即可，
my nose itches
不需要像中文那样在前面加上“我”。
Arthur, do not lift the hand holding the green brush!
「阿瑟，别抬起拿着绿刷子的那只手！」 危急关头为了让句子紧凑，用 -ing 形式的现在分词紧跟在名词后面，
the hand holding
直接说明是哪只手，直截了当。
Why are you both staring at my forehead like that?
「你们俩为什么那样盯着我的额头看？」 睁大眼睛目不转睛地盯着某处看，不仅要用 stare，还要
staring at my forehead
加上表示方向的介词 at。
Because you just painted the left lens of your reading glasses bright green.
「因为您刚刚把您的老花镜左侧镜片刷成了亮绿色。」 说明涂抹后变成的颜色，不需要额外的介词，直接把
bright green
紧跟在被涂物品的后面，干脆利落。
My glasses were on my forehead again?! Oh, everything looks like a forest!
「我的眼镜又跑到额头上了？！噢，一切看起来就像一片森林！」 由于 glasses 总是复数形式，动词也要用 were，而想要表达视觉上的相似，
looks like a forest
自然地描绘出阿瑟眼前一片绿意盎然的滑稽景象。
Stand completely still! Warm water and a soft cloth: off it comes!
「完全不要动！温水加上一块软布：一下子就擦掉了！」 把表示离开或脱落的副词 off 提到句首，
off it comes
让这句去掉污渍的话听起来充满安抚和魔力，瞬间化解了尴尬。
Clean as new! Thank you, Hannah... I think I will go supervise the front desk.
「干净如新！谢谢你，汉娜……我想我还是去前台视察一下吧。」 在口语里，go 后面经常直接加上另一个动词原形，
go supervise
这里就是指“去视察”，干脆地给自己找了个台阶下。
Wise decision, boss. Leave the wet paint to us.
「明智的决定，老板。没干的油漆活儿就交给我们吧。」 把事情托付给别人，直接用动词 leave，这里用
wet paint
从容地接过了剩下的脏活累活。现在，用自然语速把整个场景再听一遍吧。
What a lovely garden green! Give me a brush, the owner must help too!
Boss, you are wearing a snow white shirt and polished black shoes.
Just three neat slats on the bottom! I have a steady hand, watch!
Careful, Arthur, your sleeve is two centimeters from the wet edge...
Missed my shirt completely! Ha! Wait... my nose itches.
Arthur, do not lift the hand holding the green brush!
Why are you both staring at my forehead like that?
Because you just painted the left lens of your reading glasses bright green.
My glasses were on my forehead again?! Oh, everything looks like a forest!
Stand completely still! Warm water and a soft cloth: off it comes!
Clean as new! Thank you, Hannah... I think I will go supervise the front desk.
Wise decision, boss. Leave the wet paint to us.
白衬衫毫发无损，绿眼镜也及时得救，阿瑟终于安全撤退到前台那片干爽的阵地了！我们下个场景见。
See you soon!
